exams.name: Business practices and laws test
exams.notes: The board shall approve a test for applicants for licensing measuring knowledge of business practices and laws. Does not apply to residential or commercial developer endorsement applicants.
exams.quote: The board, by rule, shall approve a test for applicants for licensing under ORS 701.046. The test shall measure the applicant's knowledge regarding business practices and laws that are the subject of the training required under subsection (1) of this section.

interval_years.quote: A license is valid for two years from the date of issuance unless the license is revoked or suspended

required.quote: to qualify for the renewal of a residential contractor license the licensee must complete eight hours of continuing education during the two-year licensing period preceding the renewal

hours_per_period.quote: the licensee must complete eight hours of continuing education during the two-year licensing period preceding the renewal

period_years.quote: during the two-year licensing period preceding the renewal

value: laws, regulations and business practices (3 hours, offered by board or approved provider under agreement with board)
topical_requirements.quote: Three of the hours required under paragraph (a) of this subsection must be education regarding laws, regulations and business practices... Five of the hours required under paragraph (a) of this subsection must be education from approved providers

available.quote: the administrator with approval of the designated examining or advisory board may, when it is in the best interest of the economy of the State of Oregon, enter into a reciprocal agreement with such other state to issue without examination licenses or certificate of registration upon proof of licensing or registration in such other state and upon payment of appropriate fees

requirements.value: Reciprocal licensing available when other state's standards, qualifications and examinations are substantially similar to Oregon's; issued without examination upon proof of out-of-state licensing and payment of appropriate fees.
requirements.quote: the administrator determines that the standards, qualifications and examinations for licensing or registration of building trades and mechanical and specialty skills of another state are substantially similar to the standards, qualifications and examinations required under applicable Oregon statutes and rules

exists.quote: The Construction Contractors Board is established, consisting of nine members appointed by the Governor subject to confirmation by the Senate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a provision of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a rule or order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a rule or order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entered into a settlement agreement but failed to comply with its terms.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entered into a settlement agreement with another person under ORS 701.145 but failed to comply with the terms of the settlement agreement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Is a business entity or owner/officer/partner of a business entity subject to revocation, suspension, or civil/criminal penalty related to construction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a business entity or is the owner, director, officer or partner of a business entity or of a reorganized business entity...that was subject to a revocation or suspension of a license, or subject to a civil or criminal penalty

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitted an application that was incomplete in any material respect or included an incorrect or misleading statement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submitted an application to the board that, at the time the board issued or renewed the license or denied the application, was incomplete in any material respect or included a statement that was incorrect or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly assisted an unlicensed person to act in violation of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly assisted an unlicensed person to act in violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly assisted a licensed contractor to perform work for which the contractor is not properly endorsed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly assisted a licensed contractor to perform work for which the contractor is not properly endorsed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wrongfully failed to perform a contractual duty to pay money causing a person to file a lien.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wrongfully failed to perform a contractual duty to pay money to a person and the failure caused the person to file a lien on a structure under ORS 87.001 to 87.093.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly provided false information to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly provided false information to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Worked without a construction permit where a permit is required and the work resulted in a complaint.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Worked without a construction permit where a permit is required and the work resulted in a complaint being filed with the board under ORS 701.139.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Worked together with another contractor in a way that exceeded the allowed number of exempt-class contractors working on the same task.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Worked together with another contractor on the same task on the same job site, where one of the contractors was classed as exempt under ORS 701.035 (2)(b) and the number of contractors working together exceeded the following

disciplinary_grounds.description: Was convicted, or an owner/director/officer/partner was convicted, of enumerated crimes (murder, assault, kidnapping, rape/sodomy, sexual abuse, arson, robbery, theft, extortion).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Was convicted, or an owner, director, officer or partner of the licensee or applicant was convicted, consistent with ORS 670.280, of one of the following crimes in this state or an equivalent crime in another state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Did not pay another person for supplying labor or materials under a public improvement contract within 90 days of receiving payment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Did not pay another person for supplying labor or materials contracted for under a public improvement contract, plus the amount of interest due, within 90 days after receiving payment from a contracting agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeatedly reported bad faith or false complaints of nonpayment against contractors or subcontractors.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeatedly reported bad faith or false complaints of nonpayment against contractors or subcontractors.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in conduct as a contractor that was dishonest or fraudulent and injurious to the welfare of the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in conduct as a contractor that was dishonest or fraudulent and that the board finds injurious to the welfare of the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Hired employees while licensed as exempt under ORS 701.035.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Hired employees while licensed as exempt under ORS 701.035.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used one or more workers supplied by a worker leasing company while licensed as exempt under ORS 701.035.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used one or more workers supplied by a worker leasing company while licensed as exempt under ORS 701.035.

bonding_required.quote: An applicant for issuance or renewal of a contractor license shall file with the Construction Contractors Board a surety bond with one or more corporate sureties authorized to do business in this state in the amount set forth in ORS 701.081 or 701.084.

insurance_required.quote: A contractor who possesses a license as required under this chapter shall have in effect public liability, personal injury and property damage insurance covering the work of the contractor

definition_quote.value: A person that, for compensation or with the intent to sell, arranges or undertakes or offers to undertake or submits a bid to construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, inspect, move, wreck or demolish, for another, a building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development or improvement attached to real estate, or to do any part thereof.
definition_quote.quote: A person that, for compensation or with the intent to sell, arranges or undertakes or offers to undertake or submits a bid to construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, inspect, move, wreck or demolish, for another, a building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development or improvement attached to real estate, or to do any part thereof.

methods_authorized.quote: arranges or undertakes or offers to undertake or submits a bid to construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, inspect, move, wreck or demolish, for another, a building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development or improvement attached to real estate

insurance_personal_injury_minimum_usd.quote: Obtain general liability insurance under ORS 701.073 in an amount of not less than $500,000

contract_must_be_written.quote: A contractor may not perform work to construct, improve or repair a residential structure or zero-lot-line dwelling for a property owner without a written contract if the aggregate contract price exceeds $2,000.

right_of_rescission_days.quote: A property owner who enters into an initial written contract for the construction, improvement or repair of a residential structure or zero-lot-line dwelling on real property owned by the property owner may cancel the contract by delivery of a written notice of cancellation anytime prior to 12 midnight at the end of the next business day.

deposit_cap_fraction.quote: a contractor on probation as provided in ORS 701.102 (3) if the contractor offers to perform a home improvement, accepts a deposit of more than 50 percent of the total contract price

arbitration_clause_allowed.quote: A contract described in this section may contain a provision requiring mediation or arbitration of a dispute arising from the contract.

value: Clause limiting the right of a person to file a complaint with the Construction Contractors Board
voidable_contract_clauses.quote: A contract that is for the performance of work on a residential structure and that is subject to this chapter may not contain a provision that limits the right of a person to file a complaint described in ORS 701.140 with the Construction Contractors Board.

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: A person working on one structure or project, under one or more contracts, when the aggregate price of all of that person's contracts for labor, materials and all other items is less than $1,000 and such work is of a casual, minor or inconsequential nature

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: The provisions of this chapter are exclusive and a city, county or other political subdivision may not require or issue any registrations, licenses or surety bonds, nor charge any fee for the regulatory or surety registration of any contractor licensed with the board.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: A license is valid for two years from the date of issuance unless the license is revoked or suspended

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
